checks: Real .NET host and interactive Blazor page opened an existing vault and imported its enabled-plugin list without rewriting it.

Core foundations exercised real file-tree creation/navigation, filtered command execution, fuzzy switching, heading navigation, live counts, and split/pin/sidebar layout restoration with no community plugins installed or enabled.

Core controls removed/restored actual commands, ribbon/view resources and keyboard access, isolated state between vaults, retained unknown configuration fields, and survived disabled/enabled desktop process restarts. Templates, dated notes, unique collision handling and random-note empty/attachment cases ran through real UI.

Command palette settings added/reordered/removed real pinned commands and respected editor/conditional availability. Quick switcher opened a result with Ctrl+Enter, cancelled and created a missing nested note, and handled an empty vault without creating a file.

Real source selections, edits/undo/redo and Reading mode count frontmatter only when selected, use reference numeric/punctuation/CJK/kana/Korean/Tamil/Tibetan rules and UTF-16 emoji/CRLF lengths without writing the note.

Outline uses actual ATX/Setext metadata, excludes YAML/comments/indented and nested-length fences, nests skipped levels correctly, folds by pointer/keyboard/all controls and follows real source-cursor navigation.

Dirty heading edits, undo/redo and external saved replacements refresh the real Outline; Reading heading navigation/scroll changes active highlighting and emits the actual public Markdown scroll event.

Disable/re-enable removes owned Outline controls and retained listeners, restores counts, and full native restart or real-folder WASM reconnect retains the real files/mode without rewriting original workspace/community configuration.

The real status control hides for empty/image leaves, honors explicit app.json Live Preview, offers checked keyboard/pointer Source/Reading/Live Preview choices and applies actual in-place Markdown styles without changing native getMode semantics or file bytes.

Real formatted-text typing and task-checkbox input preserve selections, undo/redo, dirty buffers and community editor extensions across all three modes; only explicit save writes the exact original BOM/CRLF with the intended task marker changed.

CodeMirror displays an actually decoded local image, rendered table and local Mermaid image; their real Edit buttons reveal original source and revoke resources, detached task controls are inert, and Ctrl-clicking a wiki alias opens the resolved heading in a separate real Reading leaf.

Real split panes retain independent per-leaf modes with a shared document and community extensions; public same-file setViewState preserves unsaved text/history, rejects malformed source flags without disturbing the view, and retains opaque state.

Actual external writes refresh clean Source/Live Preview peers, but conflicting saved bytes cannot overwrite a dirty shared buffer; the guarded save rejects visibly to its caller and explicit discard/reload retains the external BOM/CRLF document.

Disabling Editor status removes its open menu, status button and retained listeners without disabling editing modes; native restart or actual-folder WASM reconnect preserves source flags, opaque leaf state and persisted plugin ownership while leaving app/workspace bytes and other enabled IDs unchanged.

Actual selection extraction saves previously dirty text, creates a real nested target, resolves source/template links independently, carries image/reference/footnote definitions, and retains BOM/CRLF plus real source undo/redo.

Cancel and retained closed-dialog controls write nothing; retargeted source views, unresolved relative-link transfers, post-open external/local edits and missing templates reject visibly without losing bytes, creating a target or implicitly saving concurrent local text.

Heading extraction includes children and blocks, rejects duplicate target anchors, supports Shift+Enter prepend and embed/none replacements, and selectively repairs real Markdown/properties/Canvas while whole-note and remaining-section links stay on the source.
Merge confirmation is enforced; a real preflight veto and a target changed after planning retain all source/reference files, newer target bytes and restored source panes.

Confirmed merge combines precise YAML/body data with guarded source trash and Markdown/Canvas reference repair, opens its real target and emits one owned modification/deletion; a real file-menu action also merges a non-active note and Ctrl+Enter creates its new nested target.

A real modify-event subscriber can edit an open target after commit: Note composer reports the committed-but-unsaved state, retains its text, disables repeat application and permits a normal subsequent save.

Real select/template/confirmation settings preserve unknown BOM-prefixed configuration, disable removes owned commands/dialog/listeners, and desktop restart or real-folder browser reconnect restores both composed files and enabled runtime.

An actual CommonJS plugin uses shared Menu/Item/Separator types, rich labels, checked/disabled rows, sections, viewport placement, pointer/keyboard actions and dismissal; real file/editor events carry the current TFile, MarkdownView and CodeMirror editor.

Actual editor context actions retain copy/cut/select-all, undoable CRLF-aware paste, empty-paste preservation and visible permission/stale/multiple-selection errors using a bounded clipboard API fixture; the system clipboard is never read or changed.

Closing the actual source view or disabling the plugin removes owned menus and retained button listeners; re-enable has exactly one event subscriber, and only explicit plugin toggles change community enablement.
inputEnvironment: Windows occlusion and renderer/timer background throttling disabled in disposable UI processes, including restarts; production launch is unchanged.
